hop 4 hands on only the language code and the country code

ownership_reason: Only the gold visits the characters one by one and collects the language code, the country code and the variant; hops 1-4 check fixed positions of the String and hand it on. Once the gold has created the Locale, the country code it was given cannot be cut back without re-reading the String, and no String a hop can hand on makes a collector that keeps the earlier codes return ('us', 'EN'). The convention is pinned outside the gold: the facade's javadoc ("en_GB" = new Locale("en", "GB")); StringUtils.split restarts each token after a separator (start = ++i, testSplit_StringChar); StrTokenizer.tokenize clears its work area for every token (testBasic1); StringEscapeUtils.unescapeJava empties its unicode buffer after each escape (unicode.setLength(0)); testToLocale_1Part pins the language-only form through the same chain.
